name: Vesperal-Tempest

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws a binary sunset, patient as erosion itself.
The air carries wet iron and lichen, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls solar potential controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
